lines.speaker: laras
lines.text: The last day of this run: the year-end report. The public will read our numbers.

lines.speaker: laras
lines.text: Use it all: tidy queries, honest charts, protected personal data and checked AI.

lines.speaker: kelabu
lines.text: I have a special offer today. You’ll love it.

lines.speaker: laras
lines.text: The annual report is out, and every number can be backed up. I’m proud.

lines.speaker: laras
lines.text: A good data analyst is not just good at SQL. They are honest with numbers and protect the people behind the data.
